Name: HostSwitcher
Author: lyneyy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]In Stardew Valley co-op, only the host's character can be played in single-player mode. This mod lets you swap which character holds the host slot before loading a save — so you can experience the game from any co-op farmer's perspective.[/color]
如果主持存档的朋友不再登录星露谷，但你对之前打拼的存档仍有留恋，可以通过这个mod一键将存档转移到自己的账号，从而保留珍贵的游戏回忆。

[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Start the game in Co-op mode and load your save once to register the farmhands.[/*]
[*]Return to the title screen.[/*]
[*]Press [b][[/b] (open bracket) on the title screen to open the Host Switcher menu.[/*]
[*]Select the farmhand you want to play as next session and confirm.[/*]
[*]Load the save — you'll now be playing as that character.[/*]
[/list][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Each farmer stays in their original home after the swap (no forced relocation).[/*]
[*]The main farmhouse renders correctly for its actual resident — spouse room, Robin's extension rooms, and NPC-specific decorations all display properly.[/*]
[*]Children remain in the correct house.[/*]
[*]Farm-global progress (Ginger Island boat, farm cave choice) is preserved and won't replay.[/*]
[*]Original save backup created automatically before the first swap, restorable with
[code]hs_restore_original <save_folder>[/code]from the SMAPI console on the title screen.[/*]
[/list][b]Console commands
[/b] Queue a swap (alternative to the [ menu)： hs_set_next_host <save> <farmer>
Cancel a pending swap： hs_cancel_swap <save>
Show pending swap status： hs_status
Show host and farmhand info from a save file： hs_inspect <save>
Restore save to its original pre-mod state： hs_restore_original <save>
Restore the save list display if it looks wrong： hs_restore_savegameinfo <save>
[b]
Known limitations[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer (with the original host joining as farmhand):[/b] The original host will need a new cabin to join. Visual inconsistencies may appear on the farmhand's screen. This is a known limitation and may be improved in a future version.[/*]
[*]Penny's room redecoration and certain marriage-specific events are blocked in the main farmhouse when the actual resident is a farmhand — this is intentional to prevent the wrong house from being redecorated.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[/list]
